data.one_liner: A PageView widget that automatically adjusts its height to the currently displayed page.
data.what_it_does: Provides a drop-in replacement for the standard Flutter PageView that dynamically resizes its height to fit the content of the currently active page. It supports both fixed children and builder constructors, infinite looping, and programmatic page controllers.
use_when: You have a PageView where pages have varying heights and you want the container to wrap the active page's height.
You need an infinite looping page view or carousel with dynamic heights.
avoid_when: You need a standard fixed-height PageView filling the entire viewport.
You are looking for grid layouts or other non-page view scrollables.
strengths: Dynamically adjusts height based on visible pages and viewport fraction.
Compatible with standard PageView parameters and adds an ExpandablePageController.
weaknesses: Height calculations can be complex with partial viewport fractions.

alternatives.name: carousel_slider
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a specialized carousel with indicators and built-in auto-play options rather than a raw PageView.
